full_judgment: 12. PW 2 Fazal Ahmed is the star witness for the prosecution who was in the room of the occurrence along with the deceased Kaiser Ahmed Chowdhury. This witness gave testimony that on 12-11-91 at 11-15am the deceased Kaiser Shaheb from his office room entered into his office room and sat facing him. Monir Ahmed suddenly entered into the room and asked Kaiser Shaheb whether he would be provided with a job. Kaiser Shaheb replied in the negative. Monir Ahmed then brought out the dagger from his waist and attacked Kaiser Shaheb and inflicted stab injuries. He stood up to resist the attack and then Monir stabbed him on his abdomen. This witness further testified that Khashru PW 4 with a Chair hit the dagger and by that hitting the front portion of the dagger bended.
